title: Fresh KITTI 00–10 rerun
sourceLabel: Independent sensor-input rerun · 11 sequences · 132 successful stages
protocol: Independent per-trajectory Umeyama Sim(3) translation ATE RMSE, all stride6+last support; equal-weight arithmetic mean over 11 sequences.
scope: Fresh inference with supplied weights from original images and IMU. Historical trajectories and GT were not inference inputs; scoring began after predictions were sealed. This repaired offline configuration is separate from the paper's original frozen configuration and the EuRoC metric-publication examples.
limitations: A full independent run succeeded; exact earlier target numbers were not reproduced. Native threaded execution and custom CUDA operations can vary across runs. Replay is not a measured real-time inference demonstration.
